summary: Minneapolis, Minnesota, 40-something male, 20 years of experience in IT, background in Unix systems programming and Java/J2EE, currently working on a startup while maintaining a day job, former C programmer, enjoys business side of tech, has two college-aged children, advocates for charter schools, strong belief in meritocracy, critical of corporate culture, values personal freedom and work-life balance, interested in software development methodologies (Agile, DevOps), passionate about photography and music (guitar), has a technical focus on configuration management and enterprise software, critical of traditional education systems, values diversity in tech, believes in the importance of mentorship and community support for underrepresented groups in tech.
